name: Notion MCP
summary: External Notion connector capability for searching, creating, updating, and registering approved Pipe documentation in Notion when a ticket explicitly calls for documentation sync or workspace publishing.

source.notes: Registered from the available Notion connector/app capability in the Codex environment. This entry records routing and governance only; it does not publish or sync any document by itself.

useWhen: A documentation, knowledge, governance, product, validation, or research ticket explicitly asks to publish, register, or update approved documentation in Notion.
The user asks where a document lives in Notion or requests Notion workspace search for relevant existing documentation.
A handoff needs a human-readable Notion mirror after the repository artifact has been reviewed or merged.
doNotUseWhen: The document is still draft, unreviewed, sensitive, private, or not approved for external workspace sync.
Repository or Linear state is the required source of truth and no Notion publishing was requested.
The content includes secrets, credentials, private customer data, production data, raw interview recordings, raw transcripts, or sensitive claims without explicit approval.
The task can be completed by linking a repository artifact or Linear ticket without mutating Notion.
routing.fallback: Keep the canonical artifact in the repository and link it from Linear. Record a Notion-sync follow-up if the connector is unavailable or approval is missing.

inputs.name: approvedDocument
inputs.description: Reviewed repository document, Linear document, or approved markdown content to publish, register, search, or update.
inputs.sourceOrDestination: Repository, Linear, or approved Notion workspace

inputs.name: notionDestination
inputs.description: Target Notion teamspace, page, database, or document location when publishing or updating content.

outputs.name: notionDocumentReference
outputs.description: Notion page, document, database, or search result reference with sync status and limitations.
outputs.sourceOrDestination: Linear handoff, PR note, or repository documentation index

schemas.notes: Future documentation-sync tickets may define a normalized NotionSyncRecord schema if multiple agents need to consume sync results.

allowedOperations: Register links to Notion documentation in Linear or repository handoffs
forbiddenOperations: Publish unreviewed or sensitive repository content without approval
Move canonical source of truth from Git or Linear into Notion
Upload secrets, credentials, raw customer data, production data, raw recordings, or private transcripts
Create public claims, legal claims, compliance claims, or customer evidence claims from Notion content alone

cost.costDriver: Depends on the connected Notion workspace plan, connector limits, and workspace permissions.

risks.description: Publishing to Notion can move private repository, founder, or customer context into an external workspace.
risks.mitigation: Use Notion only for approved documents and record source, destination, and approval status in the handoff.

risks.description: A polished Notion page can make draft strategy or validation hypotheses look canonical.
risks.mitigation: Label Notion pages as mirrors or working docs unless the repository artifact and Linear handoff mark them as accepted.

risks.description: Notion connector availability, permissions, and workspace structure may change.
risks.mitigation: Keep the repository artifact as source of truth and record Notion sync failures as follow-ups.

approvalTriggers: Uploading interview material or private evidence
Publishing customer-facing, legal, compliance, privacy, security, pricing, or sensitive claims
Changing which Notion workspace or teamspace is used for Pipe documentation
governance.dataBoundary: Only approved documentation may be published or updated. Raw recordings, raw transcripts, identifiable interview data, secrets, credentials, and production/customer data remain blocked unless a dedicated ticket records approval and retention rules.
governance.sensitiveActionBoundary: Notion content cannot override repository policy, Linear execution state, GitHub PR review, or approval gates.
governance.loggingRequirement: Record Notion page/document URL, source artifact, sync action, approval status, and residual risk in the Linear or PR handoff.
governance.updatePolicy: Review after first operational Notion sync and whenever connector permissions, workspace structure, or documentation source-of-truth rules change.

review.reviewNotes: Reviewed by PIP-373. Pilot entry for approved documentation sync and search only. Notion is a collaboration/search/publishing surface, not Pipe's canonical knowledge base, and it does not authorize automatic publication or externalizing sensitive material.

examples.scenario: A merged architecture plan should be mirrored into Notion for stakeholder reading.
examples.expectedUse: Use Notion MCP only after the artifact is reviewed or explicitly approved for publication, then record the Notion link in Linear or the repository index.
examples.expectedNonUse: Do not publish draft strategy, raw interviews, or sensitive claims just because a Notion connector is available.

examples.scenario: A user asks whether a prior PRD exists in Notion.
examples.expectedUse: Search Notion and report source-linked results, while preserving repository and Linear as execution source of truth.
examples.expectedNonUse: Do not treat an outdated Notion page as newer than the repository without checking source dates.
